snippet.title: BioShock 2 - Rapture Metro Pack DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
"Rapture Metro Map Pack" - Contained in the Bioshock 2 DLC are 6 new multiplayer maps, 3 new achievements, a brand new Rebirth feature, 2 new masks to wear in-game, a raise in the level cap, and a brand spankin' new gameplay type, "Kill 'em Kindly." This new mode allows players to re-enact the penultimate scene of the first Bioshock, only this time with random opponents on Xbox Live. All this for $10.


I own nothing. Purely for your viewing enjoyment.
